$comment: AI ships at sea (PRD sections 4 and 6). About 'population' ships sail at once, by role share; each role sails one class. A merchant buys at most voyageUnits a voyage, and only while the far port pays minMargin over its price; no more than maxPerRoute sail the same port pair at once. They skim a trade rather than flood it, so prices move without the player's routes drying up (checked by a route probe). Every ship on screen is drawn; sightTiles (from the player's ship, times nightSight after dark) only decides what the chart and minimap remember, and covers the whole screen with a margin. Hailing works within hailTiles. Lanes are found on a grid of laneCell x laneCell tiles. Ships lie in port portDays before sailing on. Pirates mark ports near their haven (by size, fading with distance) and lie in wait lurkDays on the lane.
